_what: Training pairs for the canonical dated-append checker (ticket a-dated-append-in-a-charter-is-a-red). Each pair is one v0-pattern match judged by the sweep (ticket the-present-tense-corpus-rewrites-once): NARRATE means the passage narrated a change and was rewritten to present tense with pointer provenance; CITE means the date is provenance (a ruling, a quote, a pointer) and the line stands. The checker this trains must reproduce these judgments from the text alone.

_pair_schema.line: line number at judgment time (line content, not number, is the durable key)
_pair_schema.matched: the matched text verbatim, as the probe's scanner reported it
_pair_schema.disposition: for narrate: the pointer that replaced the narrative; for cite: why the date is provenance and stands
